name: WINSTAR
recent: Winstar Capital 在2026年9月宣布设立规模达3亿令吉的Sukuk Murabahah计划，用于投资、购地及再融资。公司同时推进向土著投资者特别发行最多4145万新股的计划，该议案已在股东特别大会上通过。最新季度（2026年6月30日止）营收与净利均较上季增长。
notable: 宣布设立3亿令吉Sukuk Murabahah计划，用于投资、购地及再融资。
股东特别大会通过向土著投资者特别发行最多4145万新股的计划。
董事Chua Boon Hong、Lee Yong Zhi及Khoo Nee Cheng于2026年10月9日增持公司股份。
risks: 董事Chow Kian Hung于2026年10月9日间接减持31,860,834股（约10.207%）。
Khoo Kah Kheng 发出不再是大股东的通知（Notice of Person Ceasing）。
特别发行新股计划可能对现有股东造成股权摊薄。
earnings: 2026年6月30日止季度营收为8141.7万令吉，净利368.9万令吉，净利率4.5%；营收环比增长36.6%，净利环比增长39.0%，营收同比增长33.1%，净利同比增长3.4%。

recent_en: Winstar Capital announced in September 2026 a RM300 million Sukuk Murabahah programme for investments, land acquisition and refinancing. The company is also proceeding with a proposed special issue of up to 41.45 million new shares to Bumiputera investors, which was approved at an EGM. Revenue and net profit both grew quarter-on-quarter in the latest quarter ended 30 June 2026.
notable_en: Announced a RM300 million Sukuk Murabahah programme for investments, land acquisition and refinancing.
EGM approved the proposed special issue of up to 41.45 million new shares to Bumiputera investors.
Directors Chua Boon Hong, Lee Yong Zhi and Khoo Nee Cheng acquired shares on 9 October 2026.
risks_en: Director Chow Kian Hung indirectly disposed of 31,860,834 shares (about 10.207%) on 9 October 2026.
Khoo Kah Kheng lodged a Notice of Person Ceasing as a substantial shareholder.
The proposed special issue may dilute existing shareholders' equity.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was RM81.417 million and net profit RM3.689 million, with a net margin of 4.5%; revenue rose 36.6% QoQ and net profit 39.0% QoQ, while revenue grew 33.1% YoY and net profit 3.4% YoY.
